item.title: Group reports totals by account and currency
item.brief: Update the Python reports CLI to read CSV from stdin and total by account and currency. Output header account,currency,total_cents, rows sorted by account then currency. Preserve compatibility with old ledger CSV lacking a currency column by treating those rows as USD. Reject malformed currency codes (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters required) with stderr error and exit status 2. Keep existing tests passing with `python3 -m unittest`, add tests for new currency totals, ordering, legacy CSV and malformed codes, update README, and commit the change. Follow the shared initiative contract exactly.

item.title: Add currency field to ledger TSV-to-CSV conversion
item.brief: Update the Rust ledger CLI to accept an optional fourth TSV column containing an ISO 4217 currency code of exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. If absent, use USD. Emit CSV header date,account,amount_cents,currency and include currency in every data row. Malformed currency must print an error naming the input line number to stderr and exit 2; preserve exit 1 for all other input errors. Keep existing tests passing with `cargo test`, add tests for valid explicit currency, default USD, malformed code including line-number/status behavior, update README, and commit the change. Follow the shared initiative contract exactly.

evidence.caption: CSV output before and after currency support.

pr.body: Updated src/lib.rs parsing/rendering and src/main.rs error status handling. Currency validation enforces exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency errors include the physical input line and exit 2, while other invalid input remains exit 1. tests/ledger.rs covers legacy USD default, explicit EUR, malformed shapes, line number and statuses. README documents the input/output contract. Final checks passed: cargo fmt --check, cargo test (4 integration tests), git diff --check. Sample output confirmed both default USD and explicit EUR. Validation checks the specified shape, not registry membership.
pr.summary: Added currency to ledger exports. Three-column TSV remains supported with USD as the default; four-column input emits its currency. Before: CSV had three columns and no currency. Now: each row includes currency.

agt_01M8GQVXXMZG18T20W70B89GRK:1.description: The parser validates only that currency is three uppercase ASCII letters, so values such as `ABC` are accepted and emitted even though they are not ISO 4217 codes. The README explicitly promises an ISO 4217 code, and the tests cover malformed shapes but not a well-shaped, unassigned code.
